# 3 bed detached house for sale

> DNG Michael Gilmartin are delighted to bring No. 9 Derg Manor to the market. Situated just metres from the shores of Lough Derg in the popular lakeside village of Dromineer, Co. Tipperary, this beautifully presented 3 bedroom detached bungalow is set within a small and attractive development of just 12 houses.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 100 m²
- Energetická náročnost: D
- Lokalita: 9 Derg Manor, Dromineer
- Cena: 349 500 €
